evaluation_settings.protocol_note: Frozen original CLI baseline. MENU events in this CLI reset all lighthouse/object calibration; per-session exposure is audited. Replays with the corrected CLI are supplementary and excluded from this baseline. Global scene fixes made after freezing are tested separately.

protocol: Full USB replay once per capture; all references indexed; capture clock-sync window independent of replay output; 5Hz held-out error and 50Hz output coverage; no fitted time lag

summary.pooling_note: Weighted by matched error samples; each recording fits its own training transform; long/static recordings can dominate
